business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Marketplaces for total-loss vehicles, heavy equipment and commercial assets, with equipment market intelligence, parts procurement technology and asset lifecycle services.

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Auction and resale marketplaces combining digital bidding with full-service yards, plus negotiated sales and fixed-price listings.

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Buyer fees per purchase and seller commissions per sale.

customer_contract_term.label: Customer contract term
customer_contract_term.value: Multiyear vehicle remarketing agreements with insurance carriers.

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Repeat transaction fees from insurance-carrier vehicle consignments under remarketing agreements, plus SmartEquip subscription revenue.

implementation_transition_work.label: Implementation / transition work
implementation_transition_work.value: SmartEquip integration with customers’ business systems and suppliers’ parts catalogs.

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Rouse equipment pricing, valuations and performance benchmarking, plus SmartEquip parts procurement and service management.

processing_transaction_platform_7374.label: Processing / transaction platform [7374]
processing_transaction_platform_7374.value: Digital marketplaces facilitate bidding and sales for vehicles and commercial assets, with secure transaction management for equipment and truck customers.

notes: Client retention and the subscription software recurring revenue metrics are unclear.
